abstract: We establish the Tier–1 low–hanging fruit predictions of the Modal Triplet Theory (MTT) rigorously, using only topology, group theory, and selection rules—no internal metric or harmonic integrals. On a smooth oriented spin four–manifold Y_4, with three determinant line bundles obeying flux balance and pairwise twist sectors defined by the line bundles L_{ij}, we prove: (i) chiral family numbers come from a Dirac index formula; (ii) a topological criterion for Dirac vs. Majorana masses; (iii) absence of the SU(2) Witten global anomaly for three families; (iv) exact Standard–Model hypercharges from MTT difference charges; (v) full cancellation of all local gauge/gravitational anomalies; (vi) strong–CP relaxation via a central PQ–like symmetry with integer domain–wall number; (vii) forbiddance of many baryon/lepton number violating operators by line–bundle triviality; (viii) equality of photon and graviton wave speeds in the GR–compatible EFT; and (ix) the holonomy determinant/phase sum rule implied by the canonical trivialization L_{12}\!\otimes L_{23}\!\otimes L_{31}\!\cong\!\mathbb C.
